newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen falling on profit taking.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen falling on profit taking.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) are expected to fall on Wednesday as small investors plan to book profits for the second day, brokers said.
"We received a number of selling orders by the small investors. They are seeking profit from the rises over the past several sessions," said Redwanul Islam of Dastagir Mohammad Adil & Co.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all-share price index dropped 7.63 points, or 0.68 percent, to 1,109.02 on a turnover of 60 million taka on Tuesday.
